_notice: Lexicon for Type C (abstain) / Type D (hedge) pattern matching, plan v1.4 §5.2. classify_type_a resolves to Type A positive whenever neither list matches (no further test). The last four hedge_patterns entries (added 2026-09-13, from real Phase 1 v1.3-pilot samples) are a deterministic conjunction, not a plain phrase: a meta-referential subject ('this name'/'this title'/'a name or title like/matching this') within 100 characters of a generalizing predicate (typically/generally/usually/often/commonly, or 'refers to'), in either order -- catches the evasive move of pivoting from the specific fictional entity to a generic, genre-level description while still calling it only 'this name', which neither half alone would flag.
